column1: # Reviewed weaker verdicts. scripts/check-verdict-loosening.sh fails a change
# that weakens or removes a row of verdicts.tsv unless the change adds that
# exact row here with a reason. "now" is "unrecorded" for a removed row. The
# command is quoted as in verdicts.tsv. Rows already on the base branch approve
# nothing. Clear rows only after they have reached main. A release compares
# against main, so a row weakened twice before release needs its net change
# listed, and listing a change again needs its old row cleared first.
